summary: Rogers Communications filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing completion of its acquisition of Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment, raising ownership to 100% by purchasing the remaining 25% stake from Kilmer Sports Inc. for C$4.35 billion cash. No per-share price applies as MLSE is private. Rogers will fold MLSE and the Toronto Blue Jays into a new Rogers Sports unit; Keith Pelley stays MLSE CEO, Mark Shapiro stays Blue Jays CEO. Watch integration execution, leverage from the C$4.35B outlay, and any regulatory or financing follow-on.
